notes.title: Steam Next Fest: try Rubber Brawl demo now!
notes.content:
Hello everyone, 

The Steam Next Fest has just started and it’s the perfect occasion to discover the first playable demo of Rubber Brawl! You can download it on the Steam page below, go try it! 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1717330/Rubber_Brawl/
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42983864/bfc26d8eed987090b395324aafcff5dfc9e27d48.png[/img]


[h2] What is Rubber Brawl? [/h2]
Rubber Brawl is a crazy 32-player Brawler Royale where you play as... tires! Overcome the laws of physics to drive your tire to victory, and knock down your opponents along the way to be the last one standing.

Rubber Brawl is still in development and this playable demo is not representative of the final state of the game. We will continue to improve it over the next few months to prepare its release in Early Access. 

This demo will allow us to test the main features of the game and we will soon publish a roadmap of the future content we plan to add: bonuses and skills, customization, multiplayer co-op and matchmaking... 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42983864/d16725ca95e45c9233ec9a8a24ca914ea9259dfd.png[/img]


[h2] Any bug or feedback? [/h2]
We have integrated a special interface in the demo to make it easier for you to report bugs. At any time during your game, you can activate it to report a bug you encounter without leaving the game. 

You can also report them on [url=https://discord.com/invite/pieceofcake]our Discord server[/url].

We are also looking forward to your feedback on the demo! Here is a quick survey you can fill out to tell us more, it’s [url=https://forms.gle/1i4zus2S3hCWLzpo9]available here[/url].

You can also pop into [url=https://discord.com/invite/pieceofcake]our Discord[/url] if you want to talk with us and provide any comments and feedback there. 



If you have a question, you can also write us on the Steam forums or at contact@rubberbrawl-thegame.com

And if you haven’t yet wishlisted Rubber Brawl on Steam, [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1717330/Rubber_Brawl/]click here[/url].

Roll safely! 
Piece of Cake studios team
